title: Der Testfall
briefing: Im Testlabor ist ein Schluessel verschwunden.
goal: Finde heraus, wer den Schluessel hat.

missions.title: Welche Verdaechtigen wohnen in Wels?
missions.solution: SELECT name FROM suspects WHERE city = 'Wels'

correct: SELECT s.name FROM suspects s WHERE s.city IN ('Wels') ORDER BY s.name DESC
SELECT name, city FROM suspects WHERE city LIKE 'W%'

missions.title: Wann wurde Clara gesehen? Sortiere nach der Uhrzeit.
missions.solution: SELECT seen_at, place FROM sightings WHERE suspect_id = 3 ORDER BY seen_at

correct: SELECT si.place, si.seen_at FROM sightings si JOIN suspects s ON s.id = si.suspect_id WHERE s.name = 'Clara' ORDER BY si.seen_at ASC
wrong: SELECT seen_at, place FROM sightings WHERE suspect_id = 3 ORDER BY seen_at DESC
